high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "madovermarketing_mom" by Varsha Amarnath. The post was made 2 days ago and features a bold, green background with black text. The content of the post addresses the issue of single-use plastics and their impact on the environment. The text reads: "Single-use plastics are destroying our planet. People usually end up using plastic bags when they forget to carry their reusable bags to the store. What if fashion could help?"
